description: Suivi plantations 2020 pour la réhabilitation des plages de ponte des tortues marines AMEN'TORTUE is a dataset listed in Portail Open Data du TCO, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Borbonica. Projet AMEN'TORTUE, financé par EDF Réunion dans le cadre du dispositif PAPLEO (fin de réalisation le juin 2021) Il s'agit de données flore acquises dans le cadre de projets de suivi des plantations pour la réhabilitation des plages de ponte des tortues marines: les projets VELOUTIER et AMEN'TORTUE. Coverage: Territoire de la Côte Ouest, La Réunion. The portal files it under Environnement. Its keywords are TCO, Tortues, Données environnementales, AMEN'TORTUE. The portal shows 318 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-08-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-tco-re-portal.
